meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year passes through three stages: the budget estimate (February before the year), the revised estimate (February of the year) and the accounts (provisional in May after the year, audited later). The RBI's tables restate a year as it moves from one stage to the next; each stage is kept as its own series.

table.title: Select debt indicators of the central and state governments, per cent of GDP

meta.coverage: Government debt as a share of GDP: the Centre, the states and the two together, 2011-12 to 2025-26, over GDP on the 2011-12 base
meta.note: RBI, Select debt indicators of the central and state governments, per cent of GDP (DBIE report 342). Per cent of GDP at current market prices, GDP on the 2011-12 base (the RBI's note on its state-indicators table: 1999-2000 base to 2003-04, 2004-05 base to 2010-11, 2011-12 base from 2011-12; the Centre's and the combined tables divide by the same GDP, checked by their implied denominators). A different GDP base is a different ruler: never joined across bundles. The budget estimate for 2025-26 divides by the budget's own GDP projection. Stages, from the printed table's own note: accounts to 2023-24, the revised estimate for 2024-25 and the budget estimate for 2025-26, each in its own series (suffix __re and __be), never one line. Cross-checked against the printed table (Innovation Hub export of Handbook report 87): 276 of 276 figures match.
